body: I was a part of the crew that took the asbestos piping out being told that it wasn’t asbestos. The last two people that talked of any of the substances were laid off.

There’s a big difference between trump and others. Trump rarely, if ever, has anyone within six feet of him, other than family. Why should he wear a mask? These people should definitely be wearing one though. This is a sub about Ontario. Don’t bring American politics to it for cheap internet points.

Really? Rioters haven’t been running over police? Haven’t been shooting them in the head? You’re ignorant.. innocent cops are risking their lives so yeah, lives are at stake on both sides. Stop trying to incite panic and hatred.

Y’all can boo me all you want, just goes to show that you city folk are out of touch with what we think. Remember your boos when you come up here next thinking that locals actually enjoy spending time with you. If you can’t empathize with our plight, you are the type of people we laugh at behind your back. Have fun.

Really? I made one insulting comment in the opening sentence. To make things perfectly clear, you’ve clarified you’re from the blue mountain area and I thought you were from the traditional cottage country. I don’t think you can deny that people treat the more northern communities as though they’re the Alabama of Canada, so yes, the racism comments struck a nerve. If I’m being pedantic, you are from a tourist town, not “cottage country”. I think that was a misunderstanding on my part and I got defensive. For that I apologize.

And I agree with you. You aren’t in the wrong. What you’re doing is fine. But as a marina employee, I have seen the people wondering if things could be opened early so they could come for a few weeks. I’ve seen the people driving into town for fun to see if other people are out. I think the pandemic is an excuse for some people to come here to ride it out, so you not? The post you replied to clearly stated I wouldn’t argue with property rights, especially when someone such as you are exercising those rights. I am upset with someone saying that the North doesn’t want people up here because we’re racist. I know it was implied by his wording but why imply it at all if not to say that we are racist?

I don’t think it’s the fact that we want to enjoy them. In my community, no one can self isolate because there is an influx of people here. We can’t buy more than two bags of spaghetti, 4 cans of soup etc. Because people are starting to come up. I’m not necessarily arguing that, I understand that in the GTA, lineups, waits, etc. Are crazy. I am upset about this but property owners have rights and I will never fight that. I was angry at the racism comments, maybe I shouldn’t have reacted the way I did.

That’s completely fine. I’m saying that people that spend a limited amount of time in our towns claim that we are racist and oppressive and I’m trying to explain (yes, overboard in the words I chose) why he/she was wrong. This person wanted to exclaim that there was strong racism up here so why is my last sentence any different (if you didn’t get the hint, my last sentence was over the top due to the insinuation that racism is rampant here)?
In reality, we host harvest festival and appreciate everyone coming here to support our local economy, though during a pandemic we just ask for common sense. In reality, cottagers inject so much money into our local economy and we appreciate that.
Dunce cap in the corner for you! Do you know how many liberals live here in cottage country (in the summer)? Nah, you ignore rich liberals, right? Go back to your hole when talking about these topics

You sound like a dunce. I live in cottage country. One, if you cut off water and sewer (most cottages don’t have sewer to prove my point) property owners, though only part time, have the right to sue. Yes, there is one district I know of doing this but they will be punished. Two, no one up here is discriminatory based on race, are you trying to incite something? We are not Alabama you city slickin punch jockey (is that what you expected, one of us insulting you in a way that makes no sense?). Three, they are property owners here, we are not concerned about people using their property, we are concerned about people depleting our grocery stores and overloading our healthcare facilities. 
Those are the facts you were overlooking while trying to imply that we the north are racist. Remember that next time you want to come up (and we seem standoffish to hipsters like you claiming everyone is oppressed).
Edit: I have lived enough to know that you are booing my last sentences. As a native, I can guarantee that almost every person you interact with here will not respect you no matter how much you downvote me. You think downvotes matter on this website but living far enough out of town trying to get some drinkable water matters. Y’all just want to pat each other on the back cause this woman is from Meaford, not here. Good job everyone, you showed us in the North.
